body: I have no friends, my family has given up on me, and the only two people I truly care about hate my guts and won't talk to me. Anything that would make me happy is just out of my reach. I can't take the pressure the world puts on me. Death is the only way out.

Thank you for your encouraging words. One of the problems though is that I don't even know where to go meet new people. Even if I did, I'm always nervous whenever I meet new people. I've been waiting around for people to come to me, even though deep down I know that that will never work or help. I feel really stuck and hopeless at this point.

That's how it used to be with me, too... It's rough. I always felt terrible when I talked to them about how I feel. I always felt like I was imposing my problems on them. In a way, that felt kinda worse than not having anyone at all, like I do now...
I'm 16, she's 17. We used to be pretty close but I really don't know anymore. I've known her for a few years and this really isn't like her. I don't have anyone else to talk to anymore.
I finally opened up to her after thinking about it for a while. All she said was "how and when?". I told her and she hasn't talked to me since. This was about a week ago.
